criteria.name: Install and launch
criteria.pass: A debug APK builds, installs on an Android emulator API 26 or newer, launches without crash, and displays the inventory screen.

criteria.name: Create valid item
criteria.pass: Submitting a valid name and quantity creates one item with a stable ID; list and details show saved values.

criteria.name: Input validation
criteria.pass: Blank/overlong name, invalid quantity, quantity outside 0–100000, and notes over 500 characters are rejected with visible feedback and no stored mutation.

criteria.name: Edit item
criteria.pass: Editing fields updates the same item ID and updated_at; no duplicate item is created.

criteria.name: Delete confirmation
criteria.pass: Canceling deletion preserves the item; confirming deletion removes it from list and durable storage.
evidence: UI tests for cancel and confirm

criteria.name: Search
criteria.pass: Search matches case-insensitive name substrings, filters results correctly, and shows an explicit no-results state.
evidence: UI tests with multiple records and case variants

criteria.name: Durable persistence
criteria.pass: Created and edited data remains correct after activity recreation and force-stop/relaunch.
evidence: state comparison before and after relaunch

criteria.name: Offline operation
criteria.pass: All in-scope CRUD/search workflows succeed with emulator network disabled; there is no required network permission or remote dependency.

criteria.name: Empty and feedback states
criteria.pass: Fresh install shows an empty state; successful and failed operations provide understandable feedback.
evidence: UI assertions on fresh install and operation outcomes

criteria.name: Data integrity
criteria.pass: Each item has a stable unique ID; invalid operations do not change stored state; deleting one item does not modify other items.

criteria.name: Semantic source traceability
criteria.pass: Exact problem/acceptance bytes are hashed; source revision, requirements graph, ISR revision, plan, generated files, build and runtime evidence link by immutable identifiers/hashes. An independent verifier confirms required behaviors are represented and tested.

criteria.name: Negative semantic coverage
criteria.pass: Tests cover invalid inputs, canceled deletion, no search matches, offline mode and process relaunch; unsupported semantics are explicitly refused, not silently omitted.

criteria.name: Reproducibility
criteria.pass: A clean CI run against the pinned revision can regenerate candidate/evidence manifest; toolchain and dependency resolution are recorded.

verdict_rules.PASS: All AC-001 through AC-013 have direct candidate-bound evidence and independent verification succeeds.
verdict_rules.BLOCKED: Required source binding, independent verification, toolchain, build, emulator, or evidence is unavailable.
verdict_rules.no_partial_certification: Passing a subset must not be reported as benchmark PASS.
